name: Sichuan Zigong Conveying Machine Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Zigong Conveying Machine Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of conveying machinery in China and internationally. The company offers general, tubular, and horizontal turning belt conveyors; moving belt, telescopic belt, screw, and steep-angle belt conveyors; and bucket elevators for use in various industries, including electricity, steel, coal, transportation, water conservancy, chemicals, metallurgy, petroleum, and building materials. It also engages in the manufacture of distribution switch control equipment, power facility equipment, photovoltaic equipment and components, industrial automatic control system devices, metal structures, …
